title: Meditation and successful aging: can meditative practices counteract age-related cognitive decline?
journal: Geriatrie et Psychologie Neuropsychiatrie du Vieillissement
authors: Sperduti, M., Makowski, D., Blondé, P., & Piolino, P.
summary: A review of whether meditative practice can counteract age-related cognitive decline, and of what the evidence does and does not support once "successful aging" is treated as something that can be trained.
